subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my note about driving funded accounts for {Brand}, where the install is cheap and the opened account taking its first deposit is the only event that pays the P&L. The one point worth repeating: we optimize MAFO to the funded account itself and read it back through a deposit postback off your platform, so you pay for clean, validated opens at an eCPA of $84, with synthetic and duplicate opens screened out first. I can pull the channel-level funded-account read for your funnel. Worth a short look?
illustrative_flags: eCPA on the funded account of $84 (MobUpps-specific quality signal, illustrative placeholder)
register_notes: Stage 1 EN fintech neobank: references prior outreach in first sentence; restates single proof (funded-account optimization + S2S deposit postback validation); one illustrative figure (eCPA $84) flagged; soft CTA, exactly one question mark; native US English; no sign-off; no em dash; no X-not-Y (stated positively).
